composites.name: utc-process
composites.description: COPASI incremental UTC process: advances simulation state one interval at a time via CopasiUTCProcess, emitting species concentrations and reaction fluxes each step.

model_source.description: Path or URL to an SBML/COPASI model file. Defaults to the bundled Repressilator (BIOMD0000000012).

time.description: Duration per process update in model time units.

intervals.description: Number of internal integration intervals per update.

composites.name: utc-step
composites.description: COPASI UTC trajectory: runs a full time-course simulation via CopasiUTCStep and emits the numeric result (time points + species matrix) to the RAM emitter.

model_source.description: Path or URL to an SBML/COPASI model file. Defaults to the bundled Repressilator (BIOMD0000000012).

time.description: Simulation end time in model time units.

n_points.description: Number of output time points (intervals = n_points - 1).

composites.name: steady-state
composites.description: COPASI steady-state solver: computes equilibrium species concentrations and reaction fluxes via CopasiSteadyStateStep. Emits the full results dict to the RAM emitter.

model_source.description: Path or URL to an SBML/COPASI model file. Defaults to the bundled Repressilator (BIOMD0000000012).

composites.name: batch-compare-biomodels
composites.description: For each BioModel id, fetch the SBML, parse every SED-ML simulation (UTC + steady-state), then run each simulator over all jobs via a single per-simulator runner Step. Comparison reads the full nested results store and produces all-pairs nRMSE per (biomodel, sedml-doc).

biomodel_ids.description: BioModels identifiers, one per line. Each id gets one LoadBiomodelStep that writes into `models[<id>]`.

simulators.description: Simulators to run, one per line. Allowed values: copasi, tellurium, simbio. One SimulatorRunnerStep is created per entry; the runner iterates `models` and dispatches each job to its UTC or steady-state adapter.

simbio_rtol.description: LSODA relative tolerance for simbio (CVODE-comparable default). Tighten (e.g. 1e-8) for stiff models where simbio diverges from COPASI/Tellurium. Ignored by COPASI/Tellurium.

simbio_atol.description: LSODA absolute tolerance for simbio. Tighten alongside simbio_rtol for stiff models.

reference_results_dir.description: Path to a BioSimulators SED-ML reference dataset (the dir containing BIOMD*/<engine>/<version>/.../reports.h5). When set, each model's reference engines are loaded into the comparison as `reference:<engine>` and the live engines are sampled on the reference time grid. Empty (default) disables reference loading.

reference_simulators.description: Restrict which reference engines to load, one per line (e.g. copasi, tellurium). Empty (default) loads every engine present on disk for each model. Ignored unless reference_results_dir is set.

include_steady_state.description: Also run a steady-state comparison for every model. Appends a synthetic steady-state job (when the SED-ML declares none), dispatched to each engine's SteadyStateStep. BioSimulators reference data is time-course only, so steady-state jobs compare live (pbg) engines among themselves.

composites.name: biomodel-process
composites.description: Load a single BioModel into one simulator's time-coupled process, wired to a species store — a ready-to-plug module for a larger bigraph.

simulator.description: Simulator backend: copasi, tellurium, or simbio.

composites.name: compare-biomodel
composites.description: For each BioModel id in the list, fetch the SBML, run it under COPASI and Tellurium, score per-species nRMSE between the two trajectories, and render a summary-card grid (click a card to expand that biomodel's species overlay).

biomodel_ids.description: BioModels identifiers, one per line. Each id spawns its own load + COPASI + Tellurium + compare branch.

composites.name: compare-simulators
composites.description: For each BioModel id, run it under every selected simulator and score all pairs with an nRMSE matrix. (Reference CSV datasets are supported via the CLI: `pbg-biomodels compare`.)

composites.name: simbio_brusselator
composites.description: Brusselator chemical oscillator (Antimony) integrated by simbio.

k2.description: Conversion rate X->Y; tune to cross the Hopf bifurcation

composites.name: simbio_lotka_volterra
composites.description: Lotka-Volterra predator-prey oscillator (Antimony) integrated by simbio.

composites.name: simbio_repressilator
composites.description: Three-gene repressilator with Hill kinetics (Antimony) integrated by simbio.

composites.name: glucose-regulation
composites.description: Query BioModels for a text term (default 'glucose regulation'), then run every matching model under COPASI and Tellurium and score their agreement (all-pairs nRMSE).

max_results.description: Max number of matching models to compare.

composites.name: corpus-coverage
composites.description: Cross the ASCT+B-3D crosswalk's anatomical structures with the committed full-corpus catalog's organ->models index (1,096 curated BioModels, Task A) to mark model coverage, at organ granularity.

catalog_path.description: Path to the committed full-corpus catalog JSON.

composites.name: ftu-model-coverage
composites.description: Match the committed full-corpus catalog's biomodel names against a curated list of HRA functional tissue units (FTUs) by synonym substring, answering which FTUs any curated model already claims to model.

catalog_path.description: Path to the committed full-corpus catalog JSON.

composites.name: blood-vasculature-network
composites.description: Pull the HRA/VCCF vasculature data (28 FTU heart->FTU->heart paths + VCCF vessel classes) and build a directed whole-body blood-transport graph, validating every FTU closes a circuit through the heart. The topology substrate for the planned blood-circulation simulation that couples organ models through a shared blood compartment.

include_routes.description: Also emit the per-FTU ordered vessel routes, not just the summary.

composites.name: organ-vasculature-scaffold
composites.description: Store-hierarchy scaffold for the Whole-Person-Physiome model: a Vasculature tree (parathyroid vessel, renal artery, superior mesenteric artery, blood) and an Organs tree (parathyroid, kidney, small intestines, bone). No processes yet — just the state topology.

composites.name: annotation-organ-matching
composites.description: Summarize the committed annotation-based (SBML MIRIAM + BTO crosswalk) organ-matching catalog: model/organ counts and the biological-qualifier/ontology distribution behind each organ tag.

catalog_path.description: Path to the committed annotation catalog JSON.

composites.name: annotation-recall-gain
composites.description: Compare the annotation-based organ-matching catalog against the name-synonym catalog to quantify the recall gain (organs/models added) from parsing SBML MIRIAM/BTO annotations.

name_catalog_path.description: Path to the committed name-synonym catalog JSON.

annotation_catalog_path.description: Path to the committed annotation catalog JSON.
